base_training_protocol.split: temporal 80/20 windows with overlap guard band
base_training_protocol.normalization: training samples only; fixed T and SOC scales
base_training_protocol.z0: inverse independent OCV at last pre-cycle rested point; otherwise 1.0, logged per cycle
base_training_protocol.solver: classical fixed-step RK4, causal zero-order-held current/temperature
base_training_protocol.initial_state: polarization zero; windowed SOC from causal input at window start; continuous SOC initialized once at cycle start
base_training_protocol.continuous: carry states from cycle start; source metrics masked to held-out samples; identical covered-sample mask in both modes
base_training_protocol.selection: early stopping on source validation MSE; reported source held-out is validation, not an independent final test
base_training_protocol.statistics: two-sided exact paired Wilcoxon across 5 seeds; Holm across all model pairs per condition/mode/metric; NLS deterministic values repeated for pairing only

early_stop_tail: No forwardfill: median/min/max only observed seeds; late epochs may have fewer than10 seeds. Aggregates include observed seed counts.
loss_audit: UnifiedECMUDE has no compute_loss; plain nn.MSELoss through training._compute_batch_loss; LSTM also plain MSE. History residual losses are zero.
